# ghost_repository_subscription (Resource)

Watches a repository, ignores it, or sets it back to the default, for the user the provider's token belongs to. It sets which notifications that user gets about the repository; it can't manage anyone else's. Any repository the user can see can be watched, including other people's public repositories. Every repository has a level, `participating` until the user chooses another, so creating this resource adopts the current level, and destroying it sets the level back to `participating`, which stops watching or ignoring the repository. The level follows the repository when it's renamed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ghost_repository" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

# Get notified about every issue, pull request and discussion thread in the
# repository. Destroying the resource sets the level back to "participating".
resource "ghost_repository_subscription" "example" {
  repository = ghost_repository.example.full_name
  level      = "all"

  # A replaced repository starts at "participating" again; watch it again.
  lifecycle {
    replace_triggered_by = [ghost_repository.example.repo_id]
  }
}

# Other people's public repositories can be watched or ignored too.
resource "ghost_repository_subscription" "noisy" {
  repository = "some-org/noisy-repo"
  level      = "ignore"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `level` (String) Which notifications the user gets about the repository: `all` for every issue, pull request and discussion thread (watching), `participating` only for threads they take part in or are mentioned in (the default, not watching), or `ignore` for nothing, mentions included. Changing it updates the resource in place.
- `repository` (String) The repository's full name, `owner/slug`, e.g. `ghost_repository.example.full_name`, matched case-insensitively and kept as configured. Renaming the repository updates this in place; pointing it at a different repository forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The repository's full name, `owner/slug`, as configured.
- `repository_id` (Number) The numeric ID of `repository`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A subscription is imported by the repository's full name, "owner/slug".
# Every repository has a level, so any repository the token's user can see
# can be imported; one they never chose a level for imports as
# "participating".
terraform import ghost_repository_subscription.example my-user/example
```
